pages.text: Main pill families include Qi Recovery, Cultivation, Blood Burn, Clear Mind, Rejuvenation, and Divine Stride. Each has low, mid, high, supreme, and immortal grades.

The immortal Life Creation pill is a death-saving item, not a normal manual consumable. Qingdi Longevity's substitute-death effect takes priority when available; the pill is consumed only if that is on cooldown.
